description_en: Queries the parameter details of a stream mixing and relaying task
description_zh: 查询混流转推任务参数明细
name: ListRtcMPUTaskDetail

parameters.help_en:
The application ID.
The application ID consists of uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens (-), with a maximum of 64 characters
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。
应用ID由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大64字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The task ID.


The task ID consists of uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens (-), with a maximum of 55 characters.
If you specify a task ID, the query is performed based on the task ID first, and the result contains the parameter details of the stream mixing and relaying task with the specified task ID
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。


任务ID由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大55字符。
指定任务ID时，优先按任务ID查询，返回结果为指定任务ID的旁路转推任务的参数明细
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of records per page. Valid values: 1 to 100.
If you do not specify a task ID, you must specify the PageSize and PageNo parameters. In this case, the paged query results of all stream mixing and relaying tasks under the specified application ID are returned
parameters.help_zh:
单页显示记录的数量，取值范围：1~100。
未指定任务ID时，必须指定PageSize与PageNo参数，此时会返回指定应用ID下所有旁路转推任务参数明细的分页查询结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number.
If you do not specify a task ID, you must specify the PageSize and PageNo parameters. In this case, the paged query results of all stream mixing and relaying tasks under the specified application ID are returned
parameters.help_zh:
页码。
未指定任务ID时，必须指定PageSize与PageNo参数，此时会返回指定应用ID下所有旁路转推任务参数明细的分页查询结果
parameters.name: page_no

MPUTasks.description_en: The task parameter details. The parameter format is the same as the parameter format used when you call the operation to create a stream mixing task
MPUTasks.description_zh: 任务参数明细，参数明细格式与调用创建混流任务时的参数格式一致

MaxIdleTime.description_en:
The idle timeout period. Unit: seconds.
If this parameter is set, the task is automatically stopped when the task has been idle for a period longer than MaxIdleTime. If this parameter is not set, the task is stopped immediately after the channel is closed
MaxIdleTime.description_zh:
空闲超时时间，单位：秒
若设置了此参数，则会在任务处于空闲状态的时长大于 MaxIdleTime 时，自动停止该任务；若未设置此参数，则会在房间关闭后，立刻停止该任务

MixMode.description_en:
The stream mixing mode. Valid values:
0: single-stream relaying without stream mixing or transcoding. Only the original single stream is relayed. You do not need to configure stream mixing and transcoding parameters.
1 (default): stream mixing, transcoding, and relaying
MixMode.description_zh:
混流模式。取值：
0：单路转推，不混流转码，仅转推原始单路流，无需配置混流转码参数。
1（默认值）：混流转码转推

IsAliCdn.description_en:
Indicates whether the stream is relayed to Content Delivery Network (CDN). Valid values:
false: The stream is relayed to a non-Alibaba Cloud CDN.
true: The stream is relayed to Content Delivery Network (CDN)
IsAliCdn.description_zh:
是否转推到阿里云CDN。
false为转推非阿里云CDN。
true为转推阿里云CDN

Region.description_en:
The region where the requested stream mixing service resides. Valid values:
CN-Shanghai<props="china"><ph> (default)</ph></props>: Shanghai.
AP-Singapore<props="intl"><ph> (default)</ph></props>: Singapore.
EMAA-Saudi: Saudi Arabia
Region.description_zh:
请求的混流服务所在区域。取值：
CN-Shanghai<props="china"><ph>（默认值）</ph></props>：上海。
AP-Singapore<props="intl"><ph>（默认值）</ph></props>：新加坡。
EMAA-Saudi：沙特

LayoutVolume.description_en: The layout and volume SEI. If this parameter is empty, the default layout and volume SEI is carried
LayoutVolume.description_zh: 布局和音量SEI，该参数内容为空则表示携带默认的布局和音量SEI

FollowIdr.description_en:
Specifies whether to ensure that SEI is carried when sending IDR keyframes. Valid values:
0: does not ensure SEI is carried.
1: ensures SEI is carried
FollowIdr.description_zh:
发送IDR关键帧时是否确保携带SEI，取值：
0：不确保带SEI。
1：确保带SEI

Interval.description_en: The SEI sending interval. Unit: milliseconds

FollowIdr.description_en:
Specifies whether to ensure that SEI is carried when sending IDR keyframes. Valid values:
0: does not ensure SEI is carried.
1: ensures SEI is carried
FollowIdr.description_zh:
发送IDR关键帧时是否确保携带SEI，取值：
0：不确保带SEI。
1：确保带SEI

Interval.description_en: The SEI sending interval. Unit: milliseconds

PayloadContent.description_en: The payload content of the pass-through SEI

PayloadContentKey.description_en: The key value corresponding to the payload content of the pass-through SEI. If not set, the key defaults to udd
PayloadContentKey.description_zh: 透传SEI的payload内容对应的key值。不设置时，key为默认值udd

PayloadType.description_en: The custom payload_type of the SEI message. Valid values: 100 to 254. If not set, the SEI payload_type defaults to 5
PayloadType.description_zh: SEI消息的自定义payload_type，取值范围100-254。不设置时，SEI的payload_type为默认值为5

SourceType.description_en:
The video input stream type in single-stream relaying mode. This parameter is valid only when the stream type is video (StreamType=2). Valid values:
camera (default): camera.
shareScreen: screen sharing
SourceType.description_zh:
单流转推模式下视频输入流类型，当视频流（StreamType=2）时有效。取值：
camera（默认值）：摄像头。
shareScreen：屏幕共享

StreamType.description_en:
The stream type for relaying in single-stream relaying mode. Valid values:
0 (default): relay the original stream.
1: relay only the audio stream.
2: relay only the video stream
StreamType.description_zh:
单流转推模式下转推流类型。取值：
0（默认值）：转推原始流。
1：仅转推音频流。
2：仅转推视频流

UserId.description_en: The user ID for relaying. Only one stream can be relayed at a time
UserId.description_zh: 转推用户ID，一次只能转推一路流

TaskId.description_en: The task ID. This ID is the identifier of the stream mixing and relaying task
TaskId.description_zh: 任务ID，此ID为旁路转推任务的标识

TranscodeParams.description_en: The stream mixing, transcoding, and relaying parameters

Background.description_en: The global background image for stream mixing

RenderMode.description_en:
The display mode for the sub-image output. Valid values:
0: scales the image and displays a black background.
1 (default): crops the image
RenderMode.description_zh:
子画面输出时的显示模式：
0：缩放并显示黑底。
1（默认）：裁剪

URL.description_en: The URL of the global background image

EncodeParams.description_en: The encoding parameters for the relayed output

AudioChannels.description_en: The number of audio channels. Valid values: 1, 2

AudioOnly.description_en:
Specifies whether the output is audio-only. Valid values:
true: audio-only.
false (default): not audio-only
AudioOnly.description_zh:
是否为纯音频，取值：
true：纯音频。
false（默认值）：非纯音频

AudioSampleRate.description_en: The audio sample rate. Unit: Hz

EnhancedParam.description_en:
The enhanced encoding parameters in JSON string format. The supported optional configurations include profile and preset.
profile: the encoding level. When the video encoding format is H.264, the supported values for profile include: "baseline", "main", "high".
preset: adjusts the balance between encoding speed and quality. The supported values for preset include: "ultrafast", "superfast", "veryfast", "faster", "fast", "medium", "slow", "slower", "veryslow", "placebo". Each value represents a strategy for encoding speed versus output video quality, ranging from "ultrafast" (extremely fast, encoding speed prioritized) to "placebo" (pursuing ultimate quality, extremely slow encoding)
EnhancedParam.description_zh:
编码增强参数，JSON字符串，目前支持的可选配置包括profile与preset。
profile：编码级别。当视频编码格式为H.264时，profile支持的可选值包括："baseline", "main", "high"。
preset：调节编码速度和质量的平衡。preset支持的可选值包括："ultrafast", "superfast", "veryfast", "faster", "fast", "medium", "slow", "slower", "veryslow" "placebo"。每个值代表了一种编码速度与输出视频质量的策略，从"ultrafast"（极快，编码速度优先）到"placebo"（追求极致质量，编码极慢）

VideoCodec.description_en: The video encoding format. Default value: H.264

VideoFramerate.description_en: The video frame rate. Unit: fps

Layout.description_en:
The video layout information.
For video transcoding, the video layout information includes layout coordinates (X, Y), layout pane dimensions (Width, Height), and stacking order (ZOrder). For audio-only transcoding, no video layout information is included
Layout.description_zh:
视频布局信息。
视频转码时所指定的视频布局信息，包括布局坐标(X，Y)，布局窗格(Width，Height)，叠放顺序(ZOrder)；纯音频转码时，不包含视频布局信息

UserPanes.description_en: The stream mixing user pane information

BackgroundImageUrl.description_en: The background image URL of the sub-image. When the user turns off the camera or has not entered the channel, this image fills the layout position
BackgroundImageUrl.description_zh: 子画面的背景图URL。当用户关闭摄像头或未进入房间时，会在布局位置填充为此图片

Height.description_en: The pane height, as a normalized percentage

RenderMode.description_en:
The display mode for the sub-image output. Valid values:
0: scales the image and displays a black background.
1 (default): crops the image
RenderMode.description_zh:
子画面输出时的显示模式，取值：
0：缩放并显示黑底。
1（默认值）：裁剪

ChannelId.description_en: The channel ID where the stream mixing user resides

SourceType.description_en:
The video input stream type in stream mixing and transcoding mode. This parameter is valid only for video streams (StreamType=2). Valid values:
camera (default): camera.
shareScreen: screen sharing
SourceType.description_zh:
混流转码模模式下视频输入流类型，仅针对视频流（StreamType=2）有效。取值：
camera（默认值）：摄像头。
shareScreen：屏幕共享

Width.description_en: The pane width, as a normalized percentage

X.description_en: The X coordinate, as a normalized percentage

Y.description_en: The Y coordinate, as a normalized percentage

ZOrder.description_en: The stacking order. 0 is the bottom layer, layer 1 is above layer 0, and so on
ZOrder.description_zh: 叠放顺序，0为最底层，1层在0层之上，以此类推

UserInfos.description_en: The stream mixing user information. If no user is specified, all users are mixed
UserInfos.description_zh: 混流用户信息，不指定用户则所有用户混流

ChannelId.description_en: The channel ID where the stream mixing user resides

SourceType.description_en:
The video input stream type in stream mixing and transcoding mode. This parameter is valid only for video streams (StreamType=2). Valid values:
camera (default): camera.
shareScreen: screen sharing
SourceType.description_zh:
混流转码模模式下视频输入流类型，仅针对视频流（StreamType=2）有效。取值：
camera（默认值）：摄像头
shareScreen：屏幕共享

StreamType.description_en:
The stream type for relaying in stream mixing and transcoding mode. Valid values:
0 (default): relay the original stream.
1: relay only the audio stream.
2: relay only the video stream
StreamType.description_zh:
混流转码模式下转推流类型。取值：
0（默认值）：转推原始流。
1：仅转推音频流。
2：仅转推视频流
